sub_agendas_items.title: Transportation Master Plan (TMP) Council Sponsors Group
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Vivi Chi, Director, Transportation Planning, Planning, Real Estate and Economic Development, was available to answer questions from Committee.
Following brief discussions, the motion carried as presented.

motions.motion_text:
That the Rules of Procedure be suspended to consider the following motion at the September 28, 2023 meeting of Transportation Committee, in order that work may begin as soon as possible to establish the group.
WHEREAS the previous Transportation Master Plan (TMP) Council Sponsors Group established during the last term of Council was not re-established pending the completion of the Advisory Body Review report (ACS2023-OCC-GEN-0008) which was considered and approved by Council on July 12, 2023; and
WHEREAS following Council’s approval of the TMP - Part 1 (ACS2023-PRE-TP-0001) at the Council meeting of April 26, 2023, staff are preparing to launch Part 2 of the TMP; and
WHEREAS staff are seeking to re-establish the TMP Council Sponsors Group for this Term of Council to perform the roles and responsibilities in line with the functions of a Council Sponsor’s group as outlined in the Advisory Body Review report, including: provide ongoing advice to City staff in the development of Part 2 of the TMP; meet at appropriate times to review progress; make recommendations; and act as a sounding board; and
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that the Transportation Committee recommend Council re-establish the TMP Council Sponsors Group to be made up of five Members of Council, with representation from the geographic regions of East, South, West, Rural and Central areas of the City of Ottawa as well as the General Manager of Planning, Real Estate, and Economic Development, or a designate as well as other City staff as needed; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Transportation Committee direct the Office of the City Clerk to issue an Expression of Interest to Members of Council interested in being on the Council Sponsors Group; and
THEREFORE BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the proposed membership be brought forward for Council approval by motion when this matter rises to Council on October 11, 2023.
